metaDescription: Order custom felt luggage ID tags for soft, eco-friendly branding. Perfect for trade shows and corporate gifts. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Felt luggage ID tags offer a soft, tactile alternative to plastic or leather tags, making them a natural fit for eco-conscious brands and sustainable corporate gifts. The material accepts screen printing and debossing cleanly, so your logo stands out without cracking or peeling. Whether you are outfitting a sales team for a conference or assembling welcome kits for new hires, felt tags add a warm, craft-oriented feel that plastic cannot match.
